finding: The current CRAN check page lists 13 regular flavors of published 0.10.0 as OK and links an additional donttest result. That old 2026-08-25 Fedora R-devel result fails in the compare_methods example when Lantern is not loaded. The actual frozen 0.11.0 man/compare_methods.Rd example checks torch installation and tries torch_tensor inside tryCatch before calling compare_methods. The installed-package utils::example(compare_methods, run.donttest=TRUE) check used the exact successor archive installation and logged clean skips both when torch_is_installed was mocked FALSE and when the tensor probe threw the old Lantern error. This addresses the observed old failure class without relying on the 13 regular 0.10.0 results as 0.11.0 evidence.
